aomNorGullinbursti.description: Freyr's golden-bristled boar, forged by dwarves from golden wire; it shines even at night. It only answers a call in battle (Freyr's specialty Gullinbursti), leaves when it ends and cannot be recruited.

aomNorEinheri.description: Warriors chosen by the valkyries after death to dwell in Valhalla, fighting each day and rising each night until the last battle of Ragnarok. They only answer a call in battle (Valhalla, Ragnarok, Rise of the Einherjar), leave when it ends and cannot be recruited.

aomNorWalkingWoods.description: Cedars awakened by Njord tear up their roots and crush their way toward the enemy. Summoned only by the spell Walking Woods; when the battle ends they take root and leave, and cannot be recruited.

aomNorNidhogg.description: The black dragon that gnaws at the roots of the World Tree, flying up from Hel's realm. Its fire burns a whole line of enemies to ash. Summoned only by the spell Nidhogg, one per battle; it leaves when the battle ends and cannot be recruited.

aomNorWolfFire.description: Fenrir's flame has seized a Fimbulwinter Wolf and turned it into a burning beast. It exists only while the spell Fenrir's Inferno lasts, then turns back into a Fimbulwinter Wolf.

aomNorWolfPackFire.description: Fenrir's flame has seized a Fenris Pack and turned it into a burning beast. It exists only while the spell Fenrir's Inferno lasts, then turns back into a Fenris Pack.

aomNorWolfFenrirFire.description: Fenrir's flame has seized a Fenrir Wolf and turned it into a burning beast. It exists only while the spell Fenrir's Inferno lasts, then turns back into a Fenrir Wolf.

aomNorBallista.description: The Norse war machine: a great crossbow on a two-wheeled frame whose bolt can pierce several shields. Its damage grows with the hero's Attack.

aomNorRam.description: Two warriors carry an iron-shod ram against the gate. In sieges it can batter walls, gates, towers and the keep, and it deals double damage to war machines; in open battle it is weak.

aomNorRockGiant.description: The rocks at the foot of the mountain come to life; one bite takes half a wooden wall. Arrows simply bounce off it. Found only in the Rock Giant Lair, guarding a Giant's Heart.

aomNorFrostGiant.description: An ice giant come down from Niflheim; one touch of its hand turns a man into a pillar of ice. Found only in the Frost Giant Ice Cave, guarding a Giant's Heart.

aomNorMountainGiant.description: The oldest giant of the mountains. Its stone club smashes even city gates, and armor is like paper before it. Found only in the Mountain Giant Grotto, guarding a Giant's Heart.

aomNorFireGiant.description: A fire giant of Muspelheim, kin of Surtr. It does not fight up close but hurls ball after ball of fire into the enemy ranks. Found only in the Fire Giant Lava Rift, guarding a Giant's Heart.

aomNorHirdman.description: A shield-bearing retainer who stays at his lord's side. Strike him and he always strikes back, often twice.

aomNorHuskarl.description: A household warrior in heavy armor with a great shield, set in front of the archers; arrows lose half their bite against him.

aomNorRaider.description: A raider who comes and goes like the wind; the further he charges, the harder he strikes.

aomNorJarl.description: A mounted Norse chieftain. With him on the field the whole army stands taller.

aomNorDraugr.description: Undead archers crawling out of the barrows. They feel no pain and never tire.

aomNorBattleBoar.description: A giant boar in leather armor; its tusks tear through the thickest shields.

aomNorJormunElver.description: A hatchling of the World Serpent that swims through the air. Its venom keeps wounds from healing. Found only in the wild.

aomNorCommander.description: A dwarven hero of Ragnarok who marches with your hero as commander. Before battle he carves runes into the warriors' weapons; when a comrade falls, his war cry makes the rest fear death even less. Odin's ravens fly with him.
